All three agents agree on Chicago with high confidence (0.95, 1.00, 0.95), and this aligns with the historical record. The question clearly refers to Richard J. Daley (not to be confused with his son Richard M. Daley, who also served as Chicago's mayor from 1989 to 2011).

Answer: Chicago
